commit.message: docs: add memory usage help and residency measurement notes

fix(strata): keep every lane in the latent D kernel's warp reductions (prefill hang on DGX Spark) (#199)

* fix(strata): keep every lane in the latent D kernel's warp reductions

In latent_dense_kernel<true> (moe_fused.cu and its q3k copy), lanes whose
tile row lies past the end of a partly filled last tile left the epilogue
with `continue` before the full-warp __shfl_xor_sync reductions. A
full-mask shuffle that some lanes never reach is undefined behaviour; on
sm_121 (DGX Spark, GB10) the warp deadlocks, the layer never finishes and
the serve watchdog restarts the engine ("no progress for 60 s ... layer
0/1 of the prompt chunk"). Whether a prompt hits it depends on its length
mod 64, so prompts fail intermittently.

Every lane now runs the reductions and only lanes with a real row store.
The shuffles (xor 4, 8, 16) only combine lanes of the same tig, i.e. the
same token row, so a row past the end only ever feeds itself, and the
tile's spare rows repeat its last row, so their values are finite. Rows
of full tiles are unchanged bit for bit.

Assisted-by: Claude (Anthropic)

* test(strata): cover the latent D kernels on a partly filled last tile

lat_dense_d_tail_test runs fused::latent_dense_d and
fused_q3k::latent_dense_d at the Edge0 145B shapes (K 2560, 8 groups,
ell 1792) with Q8_0 and Q4_0 weights and with the q3k column scale, for
every M in 1..127. Each row must equal the same row of a run over two full
tiles bit for bit, and nothing past row M may be written. A launch that
does not finish within 10 s fails as a hang. Registered with CTest
(timeout 300 s); it skips on devices below sm_80.

Assisted-by: Claude (Anthropic)

commit.message: Localize release pages and guides in four languages
Restore colored news cards at a more compact size
Use native theme-aware text for README headings and news
Keep SVG disclosure labels clickable as native controls
Preserve airy README display typography with SVG headings
Keep three styled news updates visible and expand older releases
Refresh release presentation and separate previous-release documentation

Release acceptance fixes: desktop commit-memory reserve, bundled edge0-infer, model docs (#193)

* docs: drop the start.sh and model-bench.json note from the 145B and 120B pages

* desktop: use the edge0-infer beside the app when no executable is set

The Windows release package puts Edge0 Chat.exe and edge0-infer.exe in the same folder, yet a first start
stopped at "No edge0-infer executable is configured" until the path was entered by hand. Reading the
settings now fills an empty executable with the edge0-infer next to the app's own executable when it is
there; a path the user set is kept, and without that file nothing changes.

* desktop: read the engine status once a model is loaded

The sidebar names the device from /status, but the app polled /status only on the Status and Service pages,
so after loading a model it showed "device unknown" until one of those pages was opened.

* docs: link the Edge0 145B and 120B Hugging Face repositories

Replace the coming-soon placeholders with the four Hugging Face repositories,
add Edge0-145B and Edge0-120B badges after the ModelScope badges, and use the
README.md Edge0-120B scores (51.3 / 75.3) in the translations and the model page.

* desktop: reload with a VRAM reserve when a model leaves little commit memory

On a GPU that shares system memory (Windows on RTX Spark), the engine's
automatic expert cache fills the free VRAM, which Windows charges to the
commit limit. Edge0 145B then left ~0.5 GB of commit free and the first
generation could crash with an out-of-memory error.

A load now waits for the committed memory to stay steady for 3 s. When
less than 10 GiB is free, the engine is reloaded with --strata-arg
--vram-reserve-mib covering the shortfall (at most twice); the reserve is
remembered per model in memory-reserve.json. A model whose reload frees no
commit memory is not reloaded again. Below 8 GiB the UI shows a warning,
and an engine that dies mid-generation reports the likely cause.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

Co-authored-by: shuyuzhang <shuyu.zhang@autoark.ai>

commit.message:
Feat/edge0 strata (#180)

* edge0-strata: add the engine for Edge0 145B and Edge0 120B

edge0-strata is a fork of Strata (https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata) with
latent MoE support. It is the engine that edge0-infer starts for Edge0 145B
and Edge0 120B.

- Import the fork snapshot, without the directories that the CUDA build and
  the server do not use (apps, docker, integrations, metal, packaging, spark,
  sycl) and without the root experiment files.
- Add the launch contract with edge0-infer (version 4) and the model
  templates edge0/models/edge0-145b.json and edge0-120b.json, which read the
  released model folders as provided.
- Build on Linux and Windows with an NVIDIA GPU and CUDA 13; on Windows with
  MSVC (x64) or clang-cl (Arm64). EDGE0.md gives the build steps and the
  changes from upstream.

Co-authored-by: wjiahao1256 <wjiahao1256@gmail.com>

* edge0-infer: run Edge0 145B and Edge0 120B on edge0-strata

Export edge0-infer from the edge0-infer development repository.

- serve, chat and inspect start edge0-strata for a released Edge0 145B or
  Edge0 120B model folder, chosen by model_name in its model.json; the
  native API refuses such a folder.
- Model options du and ple-io, --strata-arg passthrough of engine
  arguments, live /status progress for delegated models, and delegated
  models in the desktop app.
- Windows x64 and Arm64 support for delegated models.
- Documentation: the two layers (edge0-infer and the engine of each model),
  docs/edge0-145b.md and docs/edge0-120b.md.

Co-authored-by: wjiahao1256 <wjiahao1256@gmail.com>

* docs: add Edge0 145B and Edge0 120B

- docs/models/edge0-145b.md: model profile, quality and measured speed of
  both models, model folders, requirements and how to run them.
- READMEs: platforms and models by engine, release status, getting started
  and documentation links for both models.
- docs/benchmarks/README.md points to the model page for these models.
- NOTICE: Strata.

* docs: Edge0 145B and Edge0 120B in the README news, quality and benchmark sections

* edge0-strata: add the Arm64 and CUDA host compiler options to the clang-cl build

* edge0-infer: serve Anthropic Messages for native models

Add POST /v1/messages (text, function tools, thinking; complete and streaming)
and POST /v1/messages/count_tokens to edge0-infer serve for native models.
LAN authentication also accepts x-api-key, in native and delegated mode.
The server guide is renamed to docs/local-server.md; links are updated.

* docs: describe the local server as OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible in the README

* edge0-strata: remove upstream benchmark results, AGENTS.md and a preview image

bench/results/ holds upstream's published results for other models,
AGENTS.md describes the upstream product and its installers, and
docs/media/pagoda-preview.webp is a 9.6 MB image that nothing in Edge0
uses. None of them takes part in the build or in serve/server.py.
EDGE0.md records the removal; SECURITY.md now sends reports to Edge0.

* docs: cover edge0-strata, Linux and Edge0 145B/120B in the contributor docs

CONTRIBUTING.md lists edge0-strata/ and states that contributions to it
are MIT-licensed like the directory; the issue forms offer Linux, NVIDIA
GPU and the two models. The README no longer calls the models
"coming soon" next to the release note.

* chore: set the version to 0.2.0

edge0-infer (engine and CLI) and the desktop app move from 0.1.0, the
Android and iOS examples and the CLI's iOS bundle from 1.0. The bug report
template's example follows.

* edge0-strata: remove upstream's refusal-removal vector, working notes and GitHub configuration

Remove data/experimental-speed-projection/ (a control vector for
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next that removes the model's refusals; not made for the
Edge0 models), docs/work/ (upstream's working notes and test logs),
.github/ (upstream's funding file, issue forms and workflows), the
Dockerfile, which copies from the removed docker/, and the product README
in seven other languages. README.md becomes a short pointer to EDGE0.md.

Also: the MIT license text in third_party/libstrix/NOTICE.md, two source
comments translated to English, links to the removed AGENTS.md and
packaging/ fixed, and EDGE0.md lists the removals.

* docs: fix the bold marks in the quality table and name ggml-tq in NOTICE

Edge0-120B's AA-LCR score (81.0) was bold although Qwen3.8-27B has 82.0 in
the same column. NOTICE names the third-party code under edge0-strata/ and
calls the server the local server.

* edge0-infer: export eb50e81 (serve review fixes; model.json with an architecture field is delegated)

Delegate mode no longer passes STRATA_API_KEY to edge0-strata, reports an engine that stops mid-response as 502/503 or a trailing error event, forwards /v1/messages/count_tokens, and sets TCP_NODELAY. Anthropic Messages accepts tool_result without content and keeps rejected tool calls out of the stream. A model.json is treated as a native Edge0 manifest only when it has format_version.

* edge0-infer: export 71fda2b (fake engine self-test no longer hangs CI)

The fake engine's child no longer holds the test's output pipe, the engine-exit check uses the fake's own record and exit code instead of what the client happens to read, and the test has a 120 s timeout.

* edge0-infer: export 8e89512 (fake engine skips the reverse lookup of its bound address)

http.server looks up the host name of the bound address (socket.getfqdn), which can take tens of seconds on GitHub's macOS runners; the fake engine does not need it. A fake that is alive but not ready now prints its stacks before the self-test fails.

* Address the second review: delegated-model wording, getting-started anchors, model card placeholders, strata product tests

- edge0-infer: local-server.md and serve_delegate.h describe delegation by format_version; nine links follow the renamed getting-started sections; a Messages tool block starts only after an open text block is closed; a non-streaming answer is parsed once.
- README, model pages: "coming soon" instead of the <MODEL_CARD_URL> placeholder; the 35B page names the Anthropic-compatible server.
- edge0-strata: remove the tests of upstream's terminal app, desktop app, Intel engine and Docker/SYCL/AMD setup; setup.py no longer offers the removed control vector; the project-maya NOTICE says the port history is upstream's.
- CI: run the delegated-engine L2 tests (fake engine, no GPU).

* edge0-infer: compare the engine's interpreter folder after resolving links

On GitHub's macOS runners the fake engine reports its interpreter under /private/var/folders while the test built the path under /var/folders, the same folder through a link.

commit.message: ci: run on macos-latest (macos-14 runners are no longer available)

ci: build edge0-infer and run its L0/L1 tests on macOS

Replaces the removed Python-only workflow. Uses the cpu preset, the same
commands contributors run locally (ctest -L "L0|L1"); L2 and above need
model fixtures or devices and stay out of CI.

chore: resync edge0-infer and refresh contributor docs

edge0-infer:
- test_check_ggml_origin: use shutil.copytree and TemporaryDirectory instead
  of cp/rm, so the L1 test also runs on Windows.
- check_docs: keep only the general Markdown rules (links, anchors, tables,
  trailing whitespace, root-style links, machine-local paths); rules for
  documents that are not part of this tree are removed.

Root docs:
- performance_report.yml: replace the outdated "~15 tok/s" placeholder with a
  figure from edge0-infer/docs/benchmarking.md.
- CONTRIBUTING: branch and commit-prefix examples no longer use "streaming",
  a concept of the removed Python framework.
- README (all languages): the license line says bundled third-party
  components keep their own licenses (see NOTICE).

docs: point the root docs at edge0-infer and keep docs/ to the models

- README (en, zh, ja, es, fr): platforms, models, design, measured
  performance, quick start, documentation, roadmap and contributing now
  describe edge0-infer; edge0-35b is supported, edge0-8b follows in a
  later release.
- docs/: remove the Python framework's architecture, attention, streaming
  and adding-a-model pages; rewrite moe.md, prerouter.md and the model
  pages to describe the models; point benchmarks/ at the engine's
  benchmarking guide and drop the old community results.
- CONTRIBUTING, PR template and issue forms: edge0-infer layout, tests and
  options instead of the Python runtime.
- NOTICE: list the third-party code edge0-infer bundles (GGML, the llama.cpp
  tokenizer code, cpp-httplib, nlohmann/json; all MIT).

feat: replace the Python framework and per-platform apps with edge0-infer

Remove python/, macos/, ios/, android/, windows/, the llama.cpp patch
bands (patches/, vendor.llama.pin, scripts/patch-green.ps1) and the
Python-only CI workflow. Add edge0-infer/, the unified on-device MoE
inference engine built on GGML: one engine and one native C++ API on
macOS, iOS, Android and Windows. The first release supports edge0-35b;
edge0-8b support follows in a later release. Chat app examples for
desktop, Android and iOS live in edge0-infer/examples/. Its README is
available in English, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish and French.

Reduce the root .gitignore to entries that apply to the whole tree;
edge0-infer/ carries its own.

edge0-infer/ is exported from its development repository at 20ca3d5.
The previous implementation is kept at tag pre-edge0-infer.
